newsitem.title: USA: Dow turns higher as blue chips show some spark.
newsitem.headline: Dow turns higher as blue chips show some spark.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks reversed their losses to turn modestly higher and tech stocks extended their torrid rally in late afternoon.

The Dow industrials stood at 7937, up 14 points late in the session. The Nasdaq Composite widened its session-long gains, surging 15 points to 1539, bringing the index's gains to more than 100 points since its July 1 close.
The gains for blue chips coincided with a mild advance in the U.S. Treasury market, where the benchmark long bond rose 4/32 to yield 6.55 percent.
Breadth flattened out on the NYSE, with advancing issues and decliners running in nearly a dead heat. On Nasdaq, advancing issues moved to a slender advantage.
